arStrings.szText: Now that is an excellent question. These fights used to be quite boring, you know. Two callow dockworkers trading half-hearted jabs until one of them sat down…dry as bone dust.
Thankfully, Marcellus knows how to draw a crowd. Your opponent will be…a bit of a challenge, perhaps, but that’s why the action is so lucrative.
Let's not think on it too much, eh? Positive attitude, that’s what I recommend.
